zone_name.description: The name of the DNS zone being managed.

zone_file.description: The path to the local DNS zone file.

bindig_source_address.description: Source address for dig queries (-b option).

bindig_keyfile.description: TSIG key file for dig queries (-k option).

bindig_tsig_key.description: Literal TSIG key for dig queries (-y option).

bindig_old_server.description: Server to transfer the old zone from (-s option).

bindig_new_server.description: Server to transfer the new zone from (-m option).

nsupdate_tsig_key.description: TSIG key for nsupdate, passed as -y option.

nsupdate_server.description: Server to send nsupdate to, passed as argument to nsupdate.

soa_serial_mode.description: SOA serial number update mode (-S option): file, date, serial, unix, or a number.

split_large_updates.description: Allow very large updates to be split (-0 option).

abort_on_packet_overflow.description: Abort if update does not fit in one request packet (-1 option).

manage_cds_cdnskey.description: Do not ignore CDS/CDNSKEY records (-C option).

manage_dnskey.description: Do not ignore DNSKEY records (-D option).

ignore_regex.description: Regex to ignore additional DNS records (-i option).

quiet_mode.description: Quiet mode, suppress output unless zones differ (-q option).

nsupdate_use_s_server.description: Tell nsupdate to send to -s server (-u option).
